candidates.change_summary: Change the value requirement so exactly 1 ether is no longer accepted (now 2 ether), changing which calls to lockInGuess succeed.
Invert the re-entry guard so lockInGuess requires a previous guess instead of forbidding one, changing when calls revert.
Store the target block as block.number instead of block.number + 1, changing the recorded guess state.
Store the target block as block.number + 2 instead of block.number + 1, changing the recorded guess state.
Remove the statement resetting guesses[msg.sender].block to 0, so the guess remains locked and settle behavior differs on subsequent calls.
Change the payout amount from 2 ether to 1 ether, changing the contract's Ether balance observable after a winning settle.
Remove the payout transfer so a winning settle no longer sends Ether, changing the balance observable after settle.
Relax the timing check from strictly greater to greater-or-equal, allowing settle to succeed one block earlier than in P.
Compute the answer from blockhash(guesses[msg.sender].block - 1) instead of the locked block, changing which guesses win.
